revision_note: Work packages K01-K09 from PRD v0.2 section 11.3. K01 has two implemented increments: the aarch64 NEON fused packed dot for Q8_0/F16 with zero-copy mapped weight blocks (CPU, validated against scalar references and the llama.cpp envelope) and the first Metal increment added with Gate C (C0/C1): device/queue owner, typed resource handles with allocation accounting, packed Q8_0 matrix-vector decode and F16/F32 utility kernels, validated against the scalar reference on real tensor shapes and real artifact tensor bytes (crates/metal, native/metal, ADR-007). The remaining packages are specified; a kernel must never be selected before its correctness gate passes, and every selection retains a validated reference fallback decision. Model execution on the GPU is not implemented yet (C2).
